title: Carolina Collection Guest Towel Stand (16.3-Inch) - Solid Brass Countertop Vanity Hand Towel Stand | Antique Copper | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep guest towels within reach of the sink while keeping the vanity tidy in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms. The Carolina Collection guest towel stand adds stable, countertop towel storage with a traditional, classic look.

  • Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
  • Coordinates with other Carolina hardware for artisan-inspired warmth
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Easy to coordinate: ideal for matching Carolina with other traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
  • Built from brass: crafted from solid brass materials
